papers.title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
papers.abstract: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. A code-coverage analysis of vLLM further shows that the evaluated live, replayed, and synthetic workloads are complementary in this configuration: each exercises Python serving paths not reached in the measured runs of the others. In a case study rolling out four large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on llm-d, experiments show that the target models reached about half the optimal concurrency, and correspondingly about 60% of the throughput, on captured workloads compared with public traces. We open-source the relevant tools and release a trace dataset.
papers.llm_reason: 今天唯一一篇把「验证工具本身准不准」当成一等问题、并给出可复跑数字的论文。做法：先用真实 agent session 抓 trace，再分三种负载（live / replayed / synthetic）打 vLLM v0.31.0（8×H200 节点），同时用 Python statement coverage 判据回答「这三种负载是不是在做同一件事」。三个硬结论都在 PDF 正文核对一致：①重放保真度——重放的 P95 输入 token 稳定落在记录的 1.18x 以内，而 live re-run 高达 4.98x（40 sessions/benchmark，HWE-Bench 配 GLM-5.3、CyberGym 配 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017），即少量录制 session 就能得到可重复的 per-session token 负载；②覆盖互补而非重复——vLLM 安装共 419,671 条可测语句（2,705 文件），本次部署可达 239,319 条，三类负载各自走到其他两类没走到的 Python 路径；③真实 rollout 的教训——四个 MoE 模型（GLM-5.3、Nemotron 3 Ultra、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017、Kimi-K3）在 H100/H200 上，用公共 trace 只达到约一半最优并发、约 60% 吞吐，目标模型自抓的 trace 才暴露出 routing imbalance，而该 imbalance 只在常量共享 prompt 前缀下出现（WEKA trace 没有这个前缀）。工程价值在于三件工具（workflow 级 OTel trace replay、per-session error reporting、合成 agentic workload 生成）都贡献回上游 kubernetes-sigs/inference-perf（实测 281 stars，docs/otel_trace_replay.md 57KB、docs/synthetic_agentic.md 9.8KB 均 HTTP 200），并发布 10,056 个 agent sessions / 241,674 次 LLM 调用，Exgentic/eval-containers 实测可达（1372 个 blob）。长期价值在于「保真度」会成为 agentic serving 评测的标准论证形式。

papers.title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
papers.abstract: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill.png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill.png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill.png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png
papers.llm_reason: 把 agent skill 从「文本指令」搬到「像素」这一步，本身是对我们 skill 资产形态的挑战：文本 skill 不可微调、绑死单一模型；像素 skill 可用梯度下降优化，且同一张图可跨模型迁移。正文核对一致的三组数字：Skill.png 在 4 个 VLM × 4 个 benchmark 共 16 组设置中胜出 9 组（配对精确 McNemar 检验 p<0.05），最大增益是无 skill 的对照之上最多 +37.8 分；推理时只占 64-256 个 image token，而对照的文本 skill 约需 900-2000 个 text token；文本与像素混合 skill 在 4 个 benchmark 中 3 个再加 6.1-15.5 分。作者还给了 ensemble 优化目标（按模型做 per-model 梯度归一化），使一张图能在多个 VLM 间迁移——这是文本 skill 做不到的。工程可验证性很好：github.com/omseeth/skill.png 实测可达（24377 个 blob、MIT 许可），且 baselines/ 下完整保留了 SkillOpt（LLM 优化循环文本 skill）、llmskill、lora 三套对照实现，analysis/ 下有 cost_comparison.py、token_comparison.py、significance.py 等复现脚本——意味着「跑出论文那张表」的成本比想象中低。对我们的直接产出：skill 不必只以自然语言存在，这直接改变了我们 skill 库的存储与分发方式。

papers.title: DailySafe: Benchmarking Dynamic Safety Awareness in Everyday Multi-Turn Multimodal Interactions
papers.abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become increasingly integrated into everyday life, their ability to provide safe and reliable assistance in realistic daily activities remains insufficiently explored. Existing safety benchmarks primarily focus on isolated harmful requests or adversarial scenarios, overlooking the safety risks that may arise as ordinary tasks unfold. In practice, users pursue legitimate goals through multi-turn, multimodal interactions, where seemingly benign requests may become safety-critical when considered alongside earlier actions and visual observations. This calls for Dynamic Safety Awareness, the ability to track evolving task conditions, recognize implicit contextual risks, and provide safe and helpful assistance. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce DailySafe, a benchmark comprising 195 naturalistic multi-turn, multi-image interactions across 10 everyday domains and 42 task categories. Grounded in authentic user dialogue topics and documented safety knowledge, DailySafe captures realistic scenarios where safety-critical evidence is progressively revealed across conversational turns and visual observations. Using case-specific safety annotations, DailySafe assesses whether MLLMs can recognize and appropriately address evolving risks while supporting users' legitimate goals, bringing multimodal safety evaluation closer to real-world everyday AI assistance. DailySafe is publicly available at: https://github.com/XuankunRong/DailySafe.
papers.llm_reason: 它把安全评测的靶子从「用户直接提出有害请求」挪到了「合法任务在多轮多图交互中途变成不安全」——这个缺口是真实存在的，而且和前一天的 ROGUE-AI 结论互补：ROGUE-AI 说没有攻击者的普通风险比提示注入更危险，DailySafe 则给了这类风险的评测口径。正文核对一致：benchmark 含 195 个自然多轮多图交互、10 个日常领域、42 个任务类别，每个案例带 case-specific 安全标注；评测 16 个 MLLM，SR/HR 均为 3 次运行均值±样本标准差。README 表格与论文 Table 1 数值一致，其中最刺眼的一组是开放权重模型：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash SR 41.03±2.71、MiMo-V2.6-Flash SR 30.60±1.07、Qwen3.8-27B SR 42.39±2.53，而两个 Qwen3-VL-8B 变体 SR 仅 6.15 与 2.91——同一代架构的紧凑模型在动态安全上几乎失效。作者自述仓库「does not provide archived model responses or reproduce historical table values by itself」，这一点必须照实说：拿不到历史输出，只能自己重跑。工程价值在于它给出的是评测方法论（把「当时可知什么」写进判据）而不是一次性榜单。

papers.title: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Personalized LLM agents must act on a user's current preferences, which change across interactions and are rarely stated in full. Existing memory systems store and retrieve content from the interaction history and leave the agent to work out which preferences still hold and where they apply. Such content does not indicate whether a preference is still current or where it applies, so agents often act on outdated or misapplied preferences. We instead treat memory as the assistant's belief about the user. Following Bourdieu's account of habitus as durable but revisable dispositions, we model the user as a latent preference state that every interaction, including the current request, both reveals and updates. The belief summarizes what the history supports about this state, and memory consists of the individual beliefs that bear on the agent's current decision, each with its evidence, scope, and status. We implement this view in HabitusMem, a trained writer that states these beliefs as text records for a frozen agent. Across two agent families, HabitusMem achieves the best results among memory systems on both PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0. Controlled analyses show that learned request conditioning drives the answering gain, while auxiliary training tasks improve tool use.
papers.llm_reason: 它批评的正是我们大部分 agent 记忆系统的实现方式：只存「发生过什么」，把「这条偏好是否还成立、适用于哪里」留给下游 LLM 现场推断，于是 agent 反复用过时偏好。它的替代方案是把记忆建模成「助手对用户的信念」——每条信念带证据、作用域与状态，且每条信念都是文本记录、可被读出与审计。正文核对一致的关键数字有一组反直觉：在 Knowledge 场景下，不给记忆的 base LLM（Qwen）反而胜过 full context 和所有基于内容的记忆——说明注入历史会干扰本来能答对的问题；而 HabitusMem 只传相关信念，在生成分上比 full context 高 13 分（Qwen）和 11 分（DeepSeek），但准确率仍低于 full context（后者不丢证据，这符合预期）。消融也很诚实：请求内容单独或训练单独各自最多只加 2.3 分，工具使用上的完整混合相对 Direct 只提升 3.3 分（Qwen）和 4.5 分（DeepSeek）。工程可验证性：github.com/csyifan/HabitusMem 实测可达（32 个 blob、Apache-2.0），含 writer.py、train_sft.py、modeling.py、prompts.py 与 splits/，是完整可训练实现而非演示代码。

papers.title: Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue
papers.abstract: LLM agents run long, multi-turn programs whose contexts grow at every step, and serving them is limited by KV cache capacity. To alleviate this limitation, systems use context compression techniques, which typically wait until the KV cache crosses a large threshold and then summarize large spans of history at once, either in the background while the agent progresses or on the critical path. These summarizations can be done using the same model running on the same engine, or using the same or a different model running on extra hardware. When running on the same engine, summarization competes with the requests being served for both compute and memory capacity. To maximize the cost-effectiveness of summarization, this paper presents a new serving system called {\em Aggron}. Aggron summarizes agentic requests at every turn and selectively summarizes only certain parts of the KV cache. As a result, Aggron retains accuracy and keeps summarization requests lightweight. Moreover, Aggron launches summarization requests from a separate {\em Summarization Queue} while the corresponding agentic request whose KV cache we want to compress is stalled in the main request queue due to head-of-line stalls. The Summarization queue utilizes compute and memory capacity left over by the head-of-line stalls in the main queue. Further, to maximize efficiency, the server issues summarizations only when it predicts that they can complete before the corresponding agentic request will finally execute. In our evaluation, we compare Aggron to state-of-the-art asynchronous summarization. At high load, Aggron reduces P99 program latency by $27$--$31\%$, and raises throughput by $1.34$--$1.40\times$.
papers.llm_reason: 它指出了一个我们平台里真实存在的浪费：agent 服务的 KV cache 压力不是均匀到来的，队列 head-of-line stall 时主请求在等，而此刻压缩用的算力其实闲置着。做法是把压缩请求丢进独立的 Summarization Queue，只在预测「压缩能在该 agentic 请求真正执行前完成」时才发起，并每轮只压 KV cache 的选定部分。正文核对一致：对比 state-of-the-art 异步摘要方案，高负载下 P99 program latency 降 27% 与 31%，mean latency 降 11% 与 15%，吞吐提升 1.34x 与 1.40x。方法论上值得单独记住的是它对 agentic serving 的刻画——请求的大部分延迟花在等准入，而不是计算。长期价值：把「压缩排队」与「KV 容量」当成一个联合调度问题，比单纯调阈值高一个层级。对我们的现实意义在于，这套设计与同日 2611.25905 讲的 serving 验证正好互补：一个讲怎么把负载压准，一个讲怎么在压准之后把排队与压缩的调度榨干。

papers.title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF), with inference available through our llama.cpp fork at https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp.
papers.llm_reason: 它抓的是一个评测错配：低比特量化方法在短文本上按困惑度标定和评测，而 agentic 长程任务的上下文是 100K token 量级、动辄上百次工具调用，两者的失配代价很高。论文给的前车之鉴数字在正文核对一致——已有 Qwen3.8-27B 的 ≤3 bit 量化在 AIME 这类短任务上追平 BF16，却在 DeepSWE 上最多只解出 BF16 的 72% 任务数。方法是把 trellis-coded post-training quantization 的标定集换成「BF16 模型在 agent session 中实际生成的 token」，从而让量化误差在真实工具调用分布上被最小化。结果：3.0 与 2.5 bit 在 DeepSWE 与 Terminal Bench 两个长程 agentic 基准上与 BF16 持平，AIME 与 RealWorldQA 也持平；2.0 bit 则落后。作者称这是首批在 ≤3 bit 上于长程 agentic 任务追平全精度的量化。工程可验证性很好：github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp 实测可达（4177 个 blob、MIT、created 2026-11-16），且 HF 权重与 fork 推理入口都给了。需要说清的是：DeepSWE 平均约 150 次工具调用，正文明确写到这个任务本身就是长程的。

papers.title: Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
papers.abstract: Agent applications are increasingly deployed, yet agent-specific attacks pose real threats to them. Upon a security incident, organizations backtrack to identify the CEP (compromise entry point), remediate the damage, and prevent its recurrence. The main artifacts available for backtracking are trajectory logs, which record agent functionalities, and source code; app(lication)-specific function call logs are often fairly limited. However, trajectory logs are at the agent functionality abstraction layer, while the CEP candidates are function calls at the app code execution layer. Due to this semantic gap, the analyst needs to manually inspect the relevant code for each CEP candidate to infer its corresponding agent functionality. In this work, we present Origin, a backtracking tool for the analyst to submit a small number of queries to identify CEPs that existing tools cannot provide. Our approach poses two challenges: (1) define the intermediate abstraction that captures the mapping relationships between the two semantic layers; (2) determine the region-to-variable mapping for constructing the cross-layer graph defined in the intermediate abstraction. Each region is a specific group of agent functionalities. Origin addresses the challenges by (1) the cross-layer dependency graph (CLDG) that connects region-inferred functions at the semantic level to the variables in the low-level taint propagation subgraph, plus the associated query language, and (2) the region inference algorithm. Case studies on five popular agent applications across eight attack incidents show that an analyst using Origin correctly identifies all the CEPs.
papers.comment: 33 pages (12 pages of main text, 3 pages of references, 18 pages of appendices), 9 figures, 12 tables
papers.llm_reason: 它处理的是我们迟早要面对的运营问题：agent 应用出了安全事故，事后要回溯「入侵入口点（CEP）」在哪。难点被它说得很准——可用的日志是 agent 功能层（trajectory log），而 CEP 候选是应用代码执行层的函数调用，两层之间有语义鸿沟，分析师只能手工翻代码去猜哪个函数对应哪个 agent 功能。它的方案是设计跨层依赖图（CLDG）作为中间抽象，配一套查询语言与区域推断算法，把语义层的 region-inferred function 连到污点传播子图里的变量。正文核对一致的结果：在五个真实 agent 应用、八起攻击事故的案例研究上，使用 Origin 的分析师正确识别出全部 CEP，且每起事故只需提交一个候选，相比完整污点图把人工检查范围缩小 64-94%。方法论上的启发值得记住：这件事的难点不是分析能力，而是缺少一个能跨越两层的中间表示。

papers.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.
papers.llm_reason: 它的诊断式设计比结论更有价值：把任务拆成 Mind（基于历史观察做决策）、Act（精确及时执行）、Mind2Act（在闭环里把两者接起来）三个视角，于是能区分「系统缺这项能力」还是「有这项能力但不会组合」。正文核对一致的结果很有说服力：最强 agent 在 Mind 上 52.7%、Act 上 39.0%，到了 Mind2Act 只剩 12.0%，而端到端策略最高不超过 3.6%——单一能力不会自动迁移到组合任务。工程量也不小：30 个仿真操作任务 × 3 个难度 × 2 种场景（Clean/Random）= 180 个配置，另有 4,500 条专家演示（75.8 小时）用于训练端到端策略，agents 与端到端策略共享任务、信息契约与评估器但分开排名，另有诊断 harness 输出 per-model profile card。仓库与项目站均可达，可信度比一般 benchmark 高。局限要说清：结论只在仿真环境成立，且最强 agent 也只有 12.0%。

papers.title: ACE-Brain-0.7: Learning Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.
papers.llm_reason: 它提出的问题很实在：长程具身任务的推理如果只基于语言先验而不落在「已观察到的执行状态」上，就会做出看起来合理但与现场不符的判断。正文核对一致的数字：ACE-Brain-0.7 是 9B VLM（Qwen3.5-9B 微调），用 370 万条问答对（来自第一人称人类视频、机器人回合与仿真）训练，在六个公开任务推理基准上平均 76.5，高于 GPT-6 Astra 的 72.7 与 Claude Opus 5.5 的 73.5；空间定位平均 75.90（七个基准）、RefCOCOg 上 Acc@0.5 达 91.25。更有价值的是消融结论：只做任务理解的模型更会利用视觉历史，也更能区分执行状态——这说明「用观察到的执行状态做接地」是可以被单独训练出来并单独测量的能力。对我们的启发偏研究侧：agent 的进度估计应当有独立评测，而不是被最终成功率掩盖。

papers.title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.
papers.llm_reason: 它对长期记忆做了一个我们迟早要面对的区分：事件本身（经历）是节点，而「这段经历如何塑造了行为倾向」是边——后者才是跨会话、跨用户可迁移的东西。结构上是双图（Episodic Graph 记交互为时序/因果/语义链接的 episode，Insight Graph 记 LLM 抽取的行为信号并按支持事件数打分），推理时直接从 insight 节点取知识、由 event-as-edge 支撑，省掉反复的 episodic 遍历；event-as-edge 还让整个图能投影到关系嵌入空间，从而在共享情境下跨用户迁移，甚至为冷启动用户推断缺失的 insight。正文核对一致的增益偏小但方向明确：LongMemEval 信息抽取 +1.48 judge 分、LoCoMo 开放域问答 +0.93、LongLaMP 抽象生成上跨用户迁移在 5% 图稀疏度下开放题 judge +0.7、ROUGE-L +3。结论是「跨用户迁移可行且不需要密集图」，这个负面结论同样有价值——它意味着不需要把所有事件全连起来。

papers.title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
papers.llm_reason: 它批评的架构问题在我们自己的多工具 agent 里同样存在：单向流水线式的工具调用把语义理解与几何重建分成前后两段，误差会累积，且失败后无法自主恢复。它的修法是把 3D 视觉定位重述为语义-几何双锚点协同：语义锚点持有目标视觉语义特征，用光流跟踪加 VLM 局部验证；几何锚点持有 3D 空间几何特征，用体素化与多关键点投影做全局空间推理；两者通过标准化的工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一步感知-动作，形成闭环。正文核对一致的结果：zero-shot 在 ScanRefer 上 Acc@0.25 达 73.6%、在 Nr3D 上整体准确率 70.4%，作者称远超此前的 zero-shot 3D-VG 方法。方法论上的可迁移点是「用双向协议把两个专用工具接成闭环，而不是用流水线串起来」——这个模式在纯文本 agent 里同样成立。局限：仅限 3D 视觉定位任务，与我们的工程距离较远。

papers.title: Decoupled Knowledge Retrieval and Compact Memory Enable Reliable Lifelong Model Editing
papers.abstract: Lifelong model editing requires continuously incorporating new facts into deployed large language models (LLMs) without expensive retraining or compromising existing capabilities. Memory-based editors offer an appealing solution by keeping the base parameters untouched, yet their practical use is hindered by linearly growing storage requirements and deteriorating retrieval performance as edits accumulate. To tackle these problems, we introduce BiSpace, a lifelong model editing framework that decouples memory retrieval from knowledge injection across two distinct representation spaces. BiSpace routes queries and identifies relevant edits in an external semantic space, while injecting the corresponding knowledge into the internal representation space of the LLM through sparse and storage-efficient updates. Extensive experiments show that BiSpace shrinks each entry's storage to only about 10.2% of the original and shows strong resilience to long edit sequences of up to 16K edits. On a more challenging benchmark, BiSpace further improves Overall Performance by more than 23% over existing methods. These results advance memory-based editing toward reliable long-term model maintenance at scale.
papers.llm_reason: 它处理的是一个具体但会随时间变糟的问题：基于记忆的模型编辑器在持续编辑下存储量线性增长、检索质量退化。它的做法是把「检索」与「注入」拆到两个表示空间——查询路由与编辑定位在外部语义空间完成，知识注入则通过稀疏且省存储的更新写进 LLM 的内部表示空间。正文核对一致的数字：每条编辑的存储压到原来的约 10.2%，在长达 16K 条编辑的长序列下仍保持韧性，在更具挑战的基准上 Overall Performance 比既有方法提升 23% 以上。方法论上的启发是清楚的：把「找到该改哪」与「怎么改进去」解耦，是长周期维护问题的通用解法。对我们的现实意义是：这条路线与我们讨论过的「模型不用重训、靠外部记忆注入知识」是同一族思路，且它给出了存储成本的具体量级。

papers.title: RAVEN: A Self-RAG Based Agent for Threat Classification and Response
papers.abstract: Security event analysis in large enterprises can be overwhelming, as each alert typically requires manual in- spection by human operators. This process is time-consuming and prone to inconsistencies, especially in high-volume Secu- rity Operations Center (SOC) environments. In this work- in-progress paper, we present RAVEN: Retrieval-Augmented Vulnerability & Event aNalysis, an agentic framework designed to support SOC analysts by automating the initial stages of alert investigation. The proposed system leverages a Self- Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Generation-based approach to provide an initial classification of security events and enables interactive refinement through analyst-in-the-loop queries. Un- like traditional approaches that rely on generic mitigation strategies, RAVEN generates context-aware remediation sug- gestions by incorporating knowledge of the target enterprise infrastructure. We implement an early-stage prototype and report preliminary results on three balanced test sets of 400 curated web payloads each (SQLi, XSS, SSTI) and a qualitative case study of mitigation generation; an evaluation on IDS- generated alerts and a user study are ongoing and outlined as remaining work.
papers.llm_reason: 它把 RAG 用在 SOC 告警初筛上，思路本身不新，但有一处细节值得记：它强调生成的缓解建议要结合目标企业自身的基础设施知识，而不是套通用缓解模板——这一点在我们给内部平台生成修复建议时同样适用。工程成熟度必须如实标注：论文自述是 work-in-progress，只报告了三个平衡测试集（每个 400 条精选 web 载荷，分别覆盖 SQLi、XSS、SSTI）上的初步分类结果与一个缓解生成的定性案例，而基于 IDS 生成告警的评测与用户研究都仍在进行中、属于剩余工作。仓库检索未命中对应开源实现；论文正文引用的 LangGraph 与 OWASP Top 10 2025 均非其自身工件。因此今天只把它存为长尾观察，不投入工程。

papers.title: Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
papers.abstract: EU-funded projects produce extensive evidence in the form of deliverables, reports, and case studies. However, this knowledge is typically scattered across projects and document structures, making it difficult to locate relevant, contextual information when making decisions. This paper introduces an Agentic AI Ecosystem that consolidates heterogeneous project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and provides adaptive access through an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline. Documents from three EU-funded projects (IMPETUS, NATALIE, and InnWater) are reconstructed into hierarchical section trees and indexed with structured metadata. Retrieval is supported by two domain-specific embedding models fine-tuned on domain data (water and climate). On top of this knowledge base, a ReAct-style controller iteratively orchestrates retrieval actions by allocating retrieval budget across domain collections and accumulating evidence until a stopping criterion is met. In a retrieval benchmark over the corpus, the proposed approach improves Mean Reciprocal Rank by 26.7% (relative) compared to a single-domain embedding baseline, indicating more consistent retrieval of relevant evidence to support cross-project knowledge synthesis and climate-resilient decision-making.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at WDSA/CCWI 2026. Proceedings publication pending
papers.llm_reason: 它是一个领域化 RAG 应用的完整小案例：把三个欧盟项目的文档重建为层次化 section tree 并用结构化元数据索引，为水与气候两个领域分别微调嵌入模型，再用一个 ReAct 式控制器跨领域集合分配检索预算、累积证据直到满足停止条件。正文核对一致的结论：在该语料的检索基准上，相对单一领域嵌入基线，MRR 相对提升 26.7%。可迁移的方法论有两条：一是「按领域分别微调嵌入模型再合并索引」比单一模型覆盖多领域更有效；二是「把检索预算显式分配到不同集合」是一个可以照抄的控制器设计。对我们有用的是设计而非结论——但它只有 8 页、2 图，语料是三个特定欧盟项目，且作者自述 Proceedings publication pending，指标口径（MRR 如何计算、检索预算如何设置）未充分展开。

papers.title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
papers.abstract: Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. Here, a Composites World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer architecture is designed to meet these requirements. The proposed architecture combines a material encoder, a Spiking Neural Network memory block that tracks the long-term internal state of the material, and transformer blocks that learn the short-term applied strain state. The system is trained in three stages: material architecture encoding, base training on short time windows, and recursive fine-tuning with scheduled sampling to suppress cumulative error drift. The trained model is disassembled at inference and coupled to a non-linear FE solver, enabling structural scale simulation of composites containing embedded defects. Benchmarks against experimental results for IM7/8552 laminates under tension, compression and transverse shear, for pristine and wrinkled composites, show that the SNN memory block successfully tracks the material internal state and results in prediction errors between 0.4% and 4.8%.
papers.llm_reason: 方向相关性低：它把复合材料有限元（FEA）求解与一个多模态脉冲神经网络代理模型结合，用于带缺陷复合材料结构的实时力学建模。方法上确有可迁移的一处设计——用 SNN memory block 追踪材料不可逆的长期内部状态、transformer block 学短期应变状态，并在推理时把训练好的模型拆开耦合进非线性 FE 求解器，预测误差在 0.4%-4.8% 之间。但这条设计与我们的 AI 工程主线没有直接接口，其数据、场景与目标（结构力学缺陷建模）也完全不在雷达覆盖的 AI 工具链内。按本轮的路由标准（新意弱 / 证据弱 / 当前相关性有限），它归入暂时忽略，仅保留最小索引以便日后回看。
